name: 3d-portfolio
description: 3D portfolio site built with React, Three.js, R3F, and GSAP.

paragraphs: This repository contains the source code for a personal 3D portfolio built with React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and GSAP. It includes animated page sections, a character scene, custom cursor interactions, and smooth transitions designed for a modern portfolio experience.
features: Responsive one-page portfolio layout with reusable section components.
3D character scene rendering powered by React Three Fiber and Three.js.
GSAP-powered animations and transitions for interactive storytelling.
Custom cursor, hover interactions, and scroll-driven visual effects.
Organized component architecture with dedicated utilities and style modules.
